items.title: Fred Staton interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 12, 2008
items.q: I started out in the church of course as a Gospel singer.

ctx.x: And meanwhile you were playing the saxophone by this time?

I started out in the church of course as a Gospel singer. I was the lead singer. And the fellow who was sponsoring us decided that we should have instruments, maybe we should have an orchestra. So he interceded for us to get instruments. Somehow or other, I don’t know how the heck he managed it, right in the middle of the depression with no money or anything, but somehow he managed to get us instruments. And my first instrument was drums. And we played in the church. We had a — what do you call it — one…
You left home with a minstrel band.
